title: Knee Push-Up
instructions: Set up for the knee push-up in the same way you'd set up for a regular push-up, only your lower body will rest on your knees and not your feet. Your body should still be straight.
Lower your body towards the floor until your torso is about 1 inch from the floor. Pause, then slowly raise your body back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your body straight throughout the exercise.
Place your hands around 36 inches apart or just past shoulder width.
Knee push-ups are also great for finishing off an intense chest workout.
